about: Boards made by crates/boardgen. Its own tests and the game's (shared/engine/generate.test.ts) hold it to them: see crates/boardgen/tests/vectors.rs.
generator: xoshiro128**, seeded with 16 bytes read as four little-endian 32-bit words
fields: seed: hex. opening: the cell asked for (row * cols + col), or null to have one picked. guessFree: whether the board was asked to need no guess, which every one in `cases` that was asked to does. openedOn: the cell the board opens on. layout: one character per cell, row after row, 1 for a mine. In `digests`, promised: whether the board came with the promise that it needs no guess; layoutDigest: FNV-1a (32 bits, hex) of the layout as one byte per cell, 1 for a mine.
